correctness.rationale: For n>=3 iid points on S¹ with f_eta(theta)=(1+eta cos(theta))/(2pi), eta in [0,1), minimal enclosing radius <1 iff a unique circular gap exceeds pi. A uniquely defined complementary arc anchor theta has mass density n f_eta(theta) p_eta(theta)^{n-1} with p_eta=(1-b sin theta)/2, b=2eta/pi. Expanding even sine powers and integrating f cos-derivative gives exactly the finite P(E) polynomial. The end slack S has conditional survival (1-q_eta(theta,s)/p_eta(theta))^{n-1}, with q_eta integral over the far endpoint sector; differentiating yields a joint density. Fixed eta>0 Laplace expansion at theta=-pi/2 gives stated sqrt(n) Gaussian anchor, p_*^{n-1} probability and independent rate-1 exponential slack on n/(pi+2eta) scale. For eta=lambda/n, uniform p expansion gives exp[-(2lambda/pi)sin theta], normalizer I0(2lambda/pi), and independent exponential slack. Joint density convergence plus unit limiting mass triggers Scheffe total-variation convergence. Geometric diameter-chord formula R=cos(S/2), C=sin(S/2)e^{i(theta+pi/2-S/2)} gives weak center/radius limits. Numerical checker source inspected; finite polynomial/quadrature and conditional simulations are not proofs of asymptotic TV. All claims restrict to fixed eta>0 or fixed lambda, not other varying rates.
